metaTitle: Custom Gold Pocket Utility Knives | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gold pocket utility knives for your brand. Unique color stands out on job sites. Bulk pricing from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gold pocket utility knives offer a distinctive look that sets your brand apart from standard silver or black options. The metallic finish catches light and attention, making them ideal for safety awards, trade show giveaways, or branded gear for construction crews. These knives pair well with laser engraving or pad printing, allowing your logo to pop against the gold surface. Durable stainless steel blades ensure reliable everyday use, while the bright color reduces the chance of losing the knife on a job site.
heroAltText: Custom gold pocket utility knives with engraved logo, metallic finish and retractable blade for bulk orders
